why: The other half of the freeze, and the one a server gets wrong by being helpful: `absence` is null exactly when the query matched something. A code meaning `fine` would make the one field a caller consults about silence ambiguous, which is the whole failure it was added to end. Paired with `rejected: null` here, because a response carries at most one of the two and this one carries neither — the query was right, it ran, and it found something.
